{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique sites
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())
print("Number of unique sites:", df['site'].nunique())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Print first few rows to inspect
print(df.head())"}
